def get_features(db, entity_ids, seed_time):
    orders = db['orders']
    items = db['order_items']
    reviews = db['reviews']
    payments = db['payments']

    # --- Убираем утечки: используем только информацию, существующую на seed_time ---

    # Позиции заказов, сделанных до seed_time
    items = items[items['ts'] <= seed_time].copy()

    # Заказы: берём только те, у которых статус/даты уже известны на seed_time.
    # Дата доставки считается известной только если доставка произошла ДО seed_time.
    ord_sub = orders[['order_id', 'customer_id',
                      'order_delivered_customer_date']].copy()
    ord_sub['delivered_known'] = (
        ord_sub['order_delivered_customer_date'].notna()
        & (ord_sub['order_delivered_customer_date'] <= seed_time)
    )
    # Если доставка ещё не произошла на момент seed_time — скрываем эту дату
    ord_sub.loc[~ord_sub['delivered_known'], 'order_delivered_customer_date'] = pd.NaT

    # Отзывы: видимы только те, что уже созданы к seed_time
    rev = reviews[reviews['review_creation_date'] <= seed_time].copy()
    rev_agg = rev.groupby('order_id')['review_score'].mean().reset_index()
    rev_agg.columns = ['order_id', 'review_mean']

    # Платежи: видимы только те, что уже существуют к seed_time
    pay = payments[payments['ts'] <= seed_time].copy()
    pay_agg = pay.groupby('order_id').agg(
        pay_value=('payment_value', 'sum'),
        pay_installments=('payment_installments', 'mean'),
        pay_types=('payment_type', 'nunique'),
    ).reset_index()

    # --- Обогащение позиций заказов ---
    items = items.merge(ord_sub[['order_id', 'customer_id',
                                 'order_delivered_customer_date']],
                        on='order_id', how='left')
    items = items.merge(rev_agg, on='order_id', how='left')
    items = items.merge(pay_agg, on='order_id', how='left')

    items['delivery_days'] = (
        items['order_delivered_customer_date'] - items['ts']
    ).dt.days

    # --- Если нет ни одной продажи — нулевой DataFrame ---
    cols = [
        'n_items', 'n_orders', 'n_customers', 'sum_price', 'avg_price',
        'max_price', 'sum_freight', 'avg_freight', 'count_review', 'avg_review',
        'avg_delivery_days', 'recent_30', 'recent_60', 'recent_90',
        'recent_30_orders', 'recent_90_revenue', 'lifetime_days',
        'days_since_last', 'days_since_first', 'months_active',
        'avg_installments', 'n_pay_types', 'avg_pay_value',
        'sales_last_30_per_active_day', 'trend_30_vs_90'
    ]
    if items.empty:
        res = pd.DataFrame(0.0, index=pd.Index(entity_ids, name='product_id'),
                           columns=cols)
        return res.reindex(entity_ids)

    # --- Основные агрегаты по товару ---
    feat = items.groupby('product_id').agg(
        n_items=('order_id', 'count'),
        n_orders=('order_id', 'nunique'),
        n_customers=('customer_id', 'nunique'),
        sum_price=('price', 'sum'),
        avg_price=('price', 'mean'),
        max_price=('price', 'max'),
        sum_freight=('freight_value', 'sum'),
        avg_freight=('freight_value', 'mean'),
        count_review=('review_mean', 'count'),
        avg_review=('review_mean', 'mean'),
        avg_delivery_days=('delivery_days', 'mean'),
        avg_installments=('pay_installments', 'mean'),
        n_pay_types=('pay_types', 'mean'),
        avg_pay_value=('pay_value', 'mean'),
    )

    # --- Окна 30/60/90 дней до seed_time ---
    for window in (30, 60, 90):
        start = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=window)
        mask = (items['ts'] >= start) & (items['ts'] <= seed_time)
        tmp = items[mask].groupby('product_id').size()
        feat[f'recent_{window}'] = tmp

    start30 = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=30)
    m30 = (items['ts'] >= start30) & (items['ts'] <= seed_time)
    feat['recent_30_orders'] = items[m30].groupby('product_id')['order_id'].nunique()
    feat['recent_90_revenue'] = items[(items['ts'] >= seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=90)) &
                                      (items['ts'] <= seed_time)].groupby('product_id')['price'].sum()

    # --- Временные характеристики ---
    first_last = items.groupby('product_id')['ts'].agg(['min', 'max'])
    feat['lifetime_days'] = (first_last['max'] - first_last['min']).dt.days
    feat['days_since_last'] = (seed_time - first_last['max']).dt.days
    feat['days_since_first'] = (seed_time - first_last['min']).dt.days

    items['ym'] = items['ts'].dt.strftime('%Y-%m')
    feat['months_active'] = items.groupby('product_id')['ym'].nunique()

    # --- Производные признаки ---
    feat['sales_last_30_per_active_day'] = feat['recent_30'] / feat['days_since_last'].clip(lower=1)
    feat['trend_30_vs_90'] = feat['recent_30'] / (feat['recent_90'] / 3.0).replace(0, np.nan)

    # --- Реиндексация и заполнение пропусков ---
    feat = feat.reindex(entity_ids)
    feat = feat.fillna(0.0).replace([np.inf, -np.inf], 0.0).astype(float)
    return feat
